niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The Dominance Stare: Psychological Power Play
ideas.angle: Shows a specific eye-movement pattern that triggers discomfort in others, making you appear more dominant. The video challenges the viewer to try it, driving comments from users reporting their results.

hook.en: Stare at their forehead to win.

ideas.reason: Power dynamics and 'dark' social hacks are currently peaking on YouTube Shorts. This specific micro-behavior (the Triangle Gaze vs. Forehead Gaze) is a high-retention topic because it offers an immediate, actionable result for social anxiety or conflict.
sources: The Definitive Book of Body Language by Allan and Barbara Pease

ideas.title: The Afterimage Glitch: Locking Your Vision
ideas.angle: An interactive test where viewers stare at a specific dot for 15 seconds to see a black-and-white image turn into full color. This forces 100%+ watch time and repeat plays to catch the transition.

hook.en: Don't blink or you'll miss this.

ideas.reason: Interactive illusions have some of the highest APV (Average Percentage Viewed) on the platform because they require the viewer to stay until the very last frame for the 'payoff'.
sources: Trohler's Fading / Opponent Process Theory of Color Vision
Visual Neuroscience Studies on Neural Adaptation

ideas.title: The Triple Nod: Psychological Compliance
ideas.angle: Explains a micro-behavior where nodding three times in a specific rhythm forces the other person to keep talking and reveal more information. The comment trigger asks: 'Who are you trying this on first?'

hook.en: Nod three times to control conversations.

ideas.reason: Social survival rules and 'illegal' feeling conversation tips are high-velocity. This specific 'Triple Nod' technique is widely used in investigative interviewing and is trending in corporate psychology circles.
sources: The Like Switch by Jack Schafer (Former FBI Agent)
Harvard Business Review on Active Listening and Compliance
